session_id.description: Optional CSSA session correlation ID. Auto-generated if omitted. For CONTINUATION MODE: pass session_id WITHOUT target/intent to resume a paused pipeline after human approval.

target.description: Absolute path to the project root or package to analyze and refactor.

intent.description: The goal/objective of the pipeline run.

plan_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of an approved implementation plan for MUTATOR integrity verification.

dry_run.description: When true, return the DAG plan as markdown without executing. Equivalent to the old compose_pipeline preview.

target_roles.description: Optional role filter (e.g. ['ANALYZER', 'CRITIC']). Only tools matching these roles enter the DAG.

reject.description: Set to true when continuing a paused pipeline to reject the plan and abort without mutations.
